message.content: {"calls": [{"tool": "chest_xray_classifier", "source_filename": "figures/9009/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To obtain normalized scores for dextrocardia and other structural findings that may support situs inversus, a key component of Kartagener syndrome."}, {"tool": "chest_xray_report_generator", "source_filename": "figures/9009/figure_1.jpg", "reason": "To generate a detailed morphological description confirming cardiac position (dextrocardia), fissure orientation (left-sided horizontal fissure indicating mirror-image anatomy), and presence/absence of bronchiectasis or cystic changes, which are critical for distinguishing Kartagener syndrome from mimics like cystic fibrosis."}], "reason": "Kartagener syndrome requires confirmation of situs inversus (dextrocardia + abdominal organ reversal) and often bronchiectasis. The classifier can flag dextrocardia but lacks anatomical detail; the report generator is needed to verify left-sided horizontal fissure (mirror-image lung anatomy) and assess for bronchiectasis. Both tools together address the diagnostic criteria while respecting tool limitations—no chronology or calibration assumed."}
